shortDescription: Databricks is in early talks to raise several billion dollars in a new round that would value the data and artificial intelligence software company at about $225 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.

children: Databricks is in early talks to raise several billion dollars in a new round that would value the data and artificial intelligence software company at about $225 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.
The deal talks are ongoing and the terms could still change, the report said
Databricks did not immediately respond to Reuters' request for comment
Databricks had said in August it raised $5 billion at a $190 billion valuation, highlighting strong investor demand for companies tied to the AI boom
Founded in 2013, Databricks provides software that helps companies store, manage and analyze data, as well as develop AI applications
and is widely viewed as a candidate for a future stock market listing
The company has previously said that its Lakebase product has exceeded a $100 million revenue run-rate, while its Lakehouse data warehousing business surpassed a $1.5 billion revenue run-rate
